title: Course portal: courses.json
description: VS Code reads this file to check courses.json and to suggest fields as you type. Each year's folder has a year.json (see year.schema.json) and each course in it a sessions.json (see sessions.schema.json).

intro.description: A line shown under the heading on the home page.

homepage.description: Where the name in the header links to.

showNotes.description: false hides the speaker notes button on every deck.

github.description: Used by the Manage page to open the right files on GitHub.

folder.description: The portal's folder inside the repository.

years.description: The year folders in content/, newest first, for example ["2026-27", "2025-26"]. Each has a year.json that says whether it is current or archived. A year folder not listed here is not shown.

templates.description: The Slide Templates reference page (course.html?c=templates). Not listed on the home page.

label.description: Heading for the list. Default: Reference.

id.description: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in web addresses, so do not change it once shared.

visibility.description: public: listed and opens. unlisted: opens from a link but is not listed. hidden: not listed and does not open.

id.description: Letters and numbers only. Also the course's folder name inside each year. The course page is course.html?c=<id>.

programme.description: Programme shown for every year, e.g. PGDM. A course's sessions.json can override it for one year.

page.description: Only for a course whose page is somewhere else. Normally left out.

label.description: Use instead of type and number for an unnumbered item, e.g. All layouts.

updated.description: Set automatically to the day you commit a change to this deck. You can also type it.
